purpose: tractable characterization of the fixed primary/sole-ablation rules, not universal N1-specific calibration
noise: stationary zero-mean Gaussian AR(1),rho0.6; each contact sqrt(0.75)*independent +sqrt(0.25)*family-shared AR noise, independently generated across trials and families

pure_null.uncertainty: Wilson95% binomial interval across240independent pure-null families; also by fixed trial/noise cell with its denominator

phenotype_challenges.targets: contacts0 and1 receive identical-shape responses; other6remain pure noise

scenarios.residual_artifact: -A*exp(-t/0.025) for t>=0, zero prestimulation; no neuronal response

phenotype_challenges.trial_variation: none in deterministic signal; trials differ by generated noise
phenotype_challenges.ground_truth: only early_negative targets have synthetic negative N1; earlypositive/latenegative/artifact cases are phenotype challenges, not all original joint nulls
phenotype_challenges.metrics: target recovery and contact/family calls by scenario/trial/noise/amplitude; separate null-contact calls; primary and soleablation retained

inference: exactly primary empirical configuration; deterministic per-family/contact seed derived with SHA256 namespace erpy-label-free-N1-calibration-v1|20260909|scenario|n_trials|noise_sd|amplitude|replicate|channel,first8bytes bigendian masked63bits
no_adaptation: no outcome-based threshold, family, scenario or seed changes; runtime improvements must preserve arrays/results and be recorded
source_reuse: old2400factorial records lack a justified170uV physical scale; retain old evidence unchanged, do not rescale after outcomes
inputs: synthetic only, no human labels or supervised models
